params.name: Qualifier
params.description: Specify a version of the function. This can be $LATEST or a published version number. If no value is specified, the configuration for the $LATEST version is returned.

items.docs: Retrieves the runtime management configuration for a function's version. If the runtime update mode is Manual, this includes the ARN of the runtime version and the runtime update mode. If the runtime update mode is Auto or Function update, this includes the runtime update mode and null is returned for the ARN. For more information, see Runtime updates.
